headline: A founder console dump became a root-cause win: the Loading bug was the inline-style extractor wiping 241 rules, now fixed at the ledger level with a gate behind it.

items.title: Cumulative inline-style extractor + dead Loading bar removed
items.insight: The Loading text the founder saw was the visible tip of a generator wiping 241 of 253 style rules on every rebuild. Fixing the extractor to accumulate instead of overwrite recovered the whole homepage's styling and closed an entire class of shell-rotation regressions.
items.evidence: Extractor cumulative + coverage-invariant; 252 rules recovered; shell 850d887c62, 330/330 vsx coverage; build:check 108 pages 0 failures.

items.title: Build-time gate against placeholder-forever widgets
items.insight: The bug survived 170 sessions because nothing watched for dead placeholders. The new gate cross-references every Loading text node against its JS renderer's reachability — a static-site check no pipeline I know of runs.
items.evidence: scripts/check-placeholder-orphans.mjs ancestor-chain aware, 6/6 self-test, wired into build:check; caught 11 candidates, all verified live.

items.title: Disaster-recovery edge cache for double-origin outages
items.insight: Last session's failover covered one origin dying; the founder's 503s proved a Pages platform blip takes out both at once. Now a seven-day stale copy answers from the edge during an incident, so an outage becomes invisible staleness instead of a broken page.
items.evidence: Deployed --env production bf71b2db; prod verified 200; X-VS-Disaster-Recovery: stale on double-5xx HTML GETs.

items.title: Trusted Types default-policy migration bridge
items.insight: Patching 167 legacy render sites one by one would stall the enforce ladder for months, so this adopts the standard default-policy bridge: one audited chokepoint now, a safe enforce flip later. Script-URL assignments stay allowlist-pinned so injection visibility never drops.
items.evidence: assets/tt-default-policy.js first in ambient-core + 6 founder-named sink fixes; rebuilt shell; preps 2026-06-12 re-probe.

items.title: First-party uptime monitoring + alerts
items.insight: The founder's outage was invisible to us because failed loads never beacon RUM. A half-hourly probe with a browser UA now emails before the founder becomes the canary — built first-party because the uptimerobot credential is still missing.
items.evidence: scripts/probe-uptime.mjs + .github/workflows/uptime-probe.yml */30; 6/6 self-test; RESEND secret confirmed in Actions.

items.title: SIL data integrity reconciled + gated
items.insight: Studio-ops flagged that this repo's scores carried an out-of-range category and a total that disagreed with its own parts. Both historical entries are corrected and a gate now blocks the malformed shape, so cross-repo dashboards read this repo without sanitization shims.
items.evidence: S173/S174 processQuality 101→100, totals 998→997 / 997→996; check-sil-integrity.mjs 5/5; Ark reply id 01JQHOLTTF798F4CE28B793898.
